goals: Verify the Movie API's ability to perform CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on movie resources.
Validate that movie data can be successfully added, updated, retrieved, and deleted via the API, and that retrieved data adheres to the expected structure and content.
activities: Send a GET request to the '/api/v1/movies' endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Assert the response 'Content-Type' header is 'application/json'.
Prepare request headers for JSON content.
Prepare the new movie data payload.
Serialize the new movie data payload to JSON.
Send a POST request to the '/api/v1/movies/add' endpoint with the serialized data.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Prepare request headers for JSON content.
Prepare the updated movie data payload.
Serialize the updated movie data payload to JSON.
Send a PUT request to the '/api/v1/movies/update' endpoint with the serialized data.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Send a GET request to the '/api/v1/movies/123456' endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Assert the response 'Content-Type' header is 'application/json'.
Parse the JSON response body.
Validate the parsed response body against the predefined schema.
Send a DELETE request to the '/api/v1/movies/delete/123456' endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
